# oystehr_user (Resource)

Manages an Oystehr project user and sets its password.

On create, the provider invites the user via the Oystehr invite endpoint and then sets the requested password. If the invite fails (including when a user with the same email already exists), the apply fails. On destroy, the user is deleted.

~> **Note** The `password` attribute is write-only: it is sent to the API but is never read back into Terraform state from the API. Increment `password_version` to re-apply the password on a subsequent apply.

~> **Note** This resource is intended for bootstrapping users in lower environments. There is generally no good production use case for Terraform-managed users.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application to invite the user to. Changing this forces a new user to be created.
- `email` (String) The email address of the user. Changing this forces a new user to be created.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password to set for the user. This value is write-only and is never read back from the API.

### Optional

- `password_version` (Number) Increment this value to trigger the password to be re-applied.
- `profile` (String) An existing FHIR profile reference to associate with the user. If set, no new profile resource is created. Changing this forces a new user to be created.
- `resource_type` (String) The FHIR resource type to create as the user's profile. Must be either 'Practitioner' or 'Patient'. Changing this forces a new user to be created.
- `roles` (List of String) A list of role IDs to assign to the user. Changing this forces a new user to be created.
- `username` (String) The username of the user. Defaults to the email address if not set. Changing this forces a new user to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the user.
